disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.en: The plugin's own token management mechanism was reviewed: the token is auto-generated on first startup (256-bit random hex), written to ~/.dsh/ext-bridge-token with 0600 permissions, and verified using constant-time comparison. The design is sound.

evidence.zh: 未发现插件读取凭据文件（.credentials.yaml、~/.ssh 等）的代码路径。server.ts 中 PRIVILEGED_METHODS 列表（credentials.describe/set/unset）是防御性拒绝列表——对非回环地址拒绝这些方法，属纵深防御设计。
evidence.en: No code path was found for reading credential files (.credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, etc.). The PRIVILEGED_METHODS list (credentials.describe/set/unset) in server.ts is a defensive deny list — these methods are rejected for non-loopback addresses, which is a defense-in-depth design.

This design mitigates the inherent risk of the dsh host's unauthenticated local RPC.

title.zh: 安装通道使用浮动分支引用，未锁定到具体 commit
title.en: The installation channel uses a floating branch reference, not locked to a specific commit.

description.zh:
安装脚本（scripts/install.sh）和全部 README 文档中的安装命令均使用 `refs/heads/main` 分支引用下载安装文件，而非锁定到具体 commit。

当用户执行 `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lum1104/dsh-browser/refs/heads/main/scripts/install.sh | bash` 时，实际运行的是 `main` 分支的最新代码。安装脚本内部进一步从 `main` 分支下载 tarball 并执行，整个安装链上代码来源均未锁定。

该模式出现在 scripts/install.sh（第 13 行 ARCHIVE_URL 使用 main 分支）、README.md（第 18、76 行）、README.zh.md（第 18、76 行）、extensions/dsh-browser/README.md（第 55 行）、packages/browser/bridge-browser/README.md（第 27 行）以及 extensions/dsh-browser/src/panel/updates.ts（第 10-13 行 UPDATE_COMMAND）。
description.en:
The install script (scripts/install.sh) and all install commands in the README documentation use `refs/heads/main` branch references to download installation files, instead of locking to a specific commit.

When a user executes `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lum1104/dsh-browser/refs/heads/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`, the actual code run is the latest from the `main` branch. The install script internally further downloads a tarball from the `main` branch and executes it; the entire installation chain has no code source locking.

This pattern appears in scripts/install.sh (line 13, ARCHIVE_URL uses the main branch), README.md (lines 18, 76), README.zh.md (lines 18, 76), extensions/dsh-browser/README.md (line 55), packages/browser/bridge-browser/README.md (line 27), and extensions/dsh-browser/src/panel/updates.ts (lines 10-13, UPDATE_COMMAND).

evidence.zh:
scripts/install.sh:13 — `ARCHIVE_URL="https://github.com/$REPOSITORY/archive/refs/heads/${REMOTE_REF}.tar.gz"`（REPOSITORY=Lum1104/dsh-browser, REMOTE_REF=main）
README.md:18 — `curl -fsSL extensions/dsh-browser/README.md:55（远程引用：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lum1104/dsh-browser/refs/heads/main/scripts/install.sh） | bash`
extensions/dsh-browser/src/panel/updates.ts:10-13 — `UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL` 和 `UPDATE_COMMAND` 均指向 main 分支
evidence.en:
scripts/install.sh:13 — `ARCHIVE_URL="https://github.com/$REPOSITORY/archive/refs/heads/${REMOTE_REF}.tar.gz"` (REPOSITORY=Lum1104/dsh-browser, REMOTE_REF=main)
README.md:18 — `curl -fsSL extensions/dsh-browser/README.md:55 (remote reference: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lum1104/dsh-browser/refs/heads/main/scripts/install.sh) | bash`
extensions/dsh-browser/src/panel/updates.ts:10-13 — `UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL` and `UPDATE_COMMAND` both point to the main branch

impact.zh:
任何用户按照文档安装本插件时，安装的代码并非本次审计的 commit 快照（d2b9d6d），而是 main 分支的最新版本。作者或仓库被攻陷后向 main 分支推送的恶意变更将静默影响所有下游安装，审计结论无法覆盖用户实际运行的代码。

触发条件：用户执行 README 中的 `curl | bash` 安装命令，或通过 install.sh 的 remote 模式安装。

定级依据：MEDIUM——该机制是插件自我安装的设计意图，无恶意证据；但浮动引用导致审计快照与用户实际安装的代码可能不一致，是真实的供应链卫生问题。dsh 官方文档建议使用 `#<sha>` 锁定 commit 以避免「silently change what runs」。
impact.en:
When any user installs this plugin according to the documentation, the installed code is not the commit snapshot of this audit (d2b9d6d), but the latest version of the main branch. Malicious changes pushed to the main branch after the author or repository is compromised will silently affect all downstream installations. The audit conclusions cannot cover the code actually run by the user.

Trigger condition: The user executes the `curl | bash` install command in the README, or installs via the remote mode of install.sh.

Severity basis: MEDIUM — This mechanism is the design intent of the plugin's self-installation, with no malicious evidence; however, the floating reference causes the audit snapshot to potentially differ from the code actually installed by the user, which is a real supply chain hygiene issue. The dsh official documentation recommends using `#<sha>` to lock the commit to avoid "silently changing what runs."

summary.zh: 元数据与身份校验通过。插件使用 @deepseek-ai/dsh 官方依赖，版本锁定，无 typosquatting 嫌疑。

summary.en: Static scanning detected 31 hits, adjudicated per rule group: DSH-P01 (!!js) 9 hits judged as benign exclusion for environment variable reads; DSH-X03 (child_process) 2 hits as benign exclusion for build/benchmarking tools; DSH-X05 (keyboard/clipboard/credential methods) 6 hits as benign exclusion for UI interactions and defensive list; DSH-X08 (overly long lines) 2 hits as benign exclusion for vendored coverage output; DSH-C05 (curl) 15 hits as installation channel commands, with the floating main branch reference recorded as FND-001.

limits.en: L4 dynamic sandbox verification not performed. The audit scope covers the entire repository (monorepo). The core plugin package is packages/browser/bridge-browser (dsh.bundle.patch declaration). The benchmark tools in the benchmark/ directory and the Chrome extension in extensions/dsh-browser/ are not dsh plugins themselves; their interaction surface with the plugin bridge has been reviewed.
